chunks: Surely your Lord will reward everyone in accordance with his deeds. He is certainly aware of all they do.
ai.seo_question: How does God reward human deeds according to Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of 'Ilm (knowledge) as the basis for 'Adl (justice), affirming that Allah’s recompense is precise and exhaustive, leaving no deed unaccounted for. It serves as a reminder of the ultimate accountability (Hisab) where every action, whether major or minor, is recorded and returned to its doer in full measure.
